key_points: HSBC announced results date coinciding with a 3.92% intraday stock drop.
Pre‑market trading shows HSBC down ~0.3% to EUR 17.54.
Consumer complaint about a £6,000 credit‑card error highlights operational risk.
Share buyback of 48.7m shares and voting‑rights update are modestly supportive.
Launch of HSBC RedCoin stablecoin and expanded Calypso tie‑up with Nasdaq add minor innovation upside.
